label: Whatever is GOD_4 is maximal in being, from causing being
meaning: Sibling of GOD-MAXIMAL-FROM-CAUSING with the instance at esse of 'more such' (formal reading, same MoreIn) in place of the unrestricted premise, which that proof uses only at esse. Let g be GOD_4 and y another being. g causes y's being, so g is more in being than y and so has being. If some z were more in being than g, then z = g contradicts asymmetry, and z distinct from g is caused to be by g, so g is more in being than z, again against asymmetry. Each premise except excluded middle is needed in a checked interpretation (omission models); control 5 is a model with a God that causes another's being. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
